gravity.source: stationary actual accelerometer, transformed by actual SLAM IMU quaternion

cloud_admission.body_pairing: nearest already received SLAM body pose, including possible newer source header; wall-causal, not strict source-time causal

evidence_limits.overflow: failed evidence and nonzero exit, never silently complete

geometry.plane_normal_source: fit original actual XYZ, raw normal fields unused
geometry.layers: retain all measured support planes, current layer based on actual SLAM body/observed support relation
geometry.complete_edge_evidence: both sides: interior support observations, actual external drop returns and fitted near-vertical side faces
geometry.complete_connection_evidence: both actual adjacent horizontal platform seams and unique current-layer connection

review_gate: Registration candidates require independent review before a new request/profile/controller variant is authorized; this module never enables control.
